protocol: Regular EDFM full benchmark, original zero initial state and timestep schedule; cuts allowed; fresh ILU0; native cell order; LINTOL=1e-2; RTOL=DUTOL=1e-6
pressure_protocol: Native pressure BiCGStab/AMG, strict, initial tolerance 1e-6, floor 1e-12; explicit pressure cap when specified, otherwise inherits LINMAX. Pressure failures are not transport failures.
common_horizon_rule: Largest scheduled reporting time reached by every recorded case; no extrapolation or outcome-optimized cutoff
